title: A twinkly star
done: Twinkle, twinkle, little star. A yellow star with orange points.

steps.say: Lay it flat on the table. Top row, left to right, the first pointing down, then up, down and so on: 3 gaps, an orange triangle.
Next row down, left to right, the first pointing up, then down, up and so on: a gap, an orange triangle, 3 yellow triangles, an orange triangle.
Next row down, left to right, the first pointing down, then up, down and so on: a gap, an orange triangle, 3 yellow triangles, an orange triangle.
Next row down, left to right, the first pointing up, then down, up and so on: 3 gaps, an orange triangle.
